samples.user_query: Yaar app mein glitch aa gaya hai, atm machine hang ho gayi transaction ke darmian, card wapas mil gaya par pesy nai niklay. (aaj subha 10 baje 1,000 bheje thay). can you fix this ASAP?
samples.response:
Ji moazzaz sarif, aap ko pesh anay wali takleef ke liye hum nihayat maazrat khwah hain. Aap bilkul fikar na karein, hum aap ki poori madad karein ge.

Aksar auqaat ATM machine hang honay par raqam thori der mein khud-bakhud aap ke account mein wapas (auto-reverse) ho jati hai. State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) ke qawaneen ke mutabiq, ATM cash reversal mein **24 se 48 working hours** lag saktay hain.

Aap se guzarish hai ke:
1. Thori der baad apna account statement/balance check farma lein.
2. Agar raqam wapas na aye, toh barah-e-karam transaction ki receipt ya transaction ID aur muta'aliqa ATM bank ka naam yahan share farma dein taake hum aap ki complaint darj kar sakein.

*Zaroori Hifazati Hidayat: Zarya Digital Bank kabhi bhi aap se aap ka ATM PIN, OTP ya Password nahi mangta, barah-e-karam ye kisi ke sath share na karein.*

Kya is hawale se main aap ki mazeed koi madad kar sakta hoon?

samples.user_query: Bhai mera masla hal karo! Ek mobile no par do banks ki Raast ID ban sakti hai kya? Kitni der lagegi??
samples.response:
Ji moazzaz sarif, Assalam-o-Alaikum! Hum aap ki poori rehnumai ke liye hazir hain.

State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) ke qawaneen ke mutabiq, **ek mobile number par ek waqt mein sirf ek hi bank account ki Raast ID link ho sakti hai.** 

Agar aap apna mobile number kisi doosray bank ke sath Raast ID ke tor par link karein ge, toh pehlay bank se aap ki Raast ID khud-ba-khud delink ho kar naye bank account ke sath jud jaye gi.

**Waqt (Turnaround Time):** 
Raast ID ki registration ya tabdeeli aam tor par fori ho jati hai, taham SBP ke turnaround time ke mutabiq is amal mein **24 working hours** tak lag saktay hain.

Agar aap ko mazeed koi maloomat darkar hon toh zaroor aagah kijiye ga, hum aap ki khidmat ke liye hamesha tayyar hain!

samples.user_query: Bohat pareshani hai, unauthorized activity hui he mere account pe! Debit card block karna hai, gum ho gaya hai Please mera account foran secure karein!
samples.response:
Assalam-o-Alaikum! Ji moazzaz sarif, aapki pareshani hum ba-khoobi samajh saktay hain. Aap bilkul fikar na karein, aapka account secure karna hamari awaleen tarjeeh hai.

Aap foran yeh iqdamat karein:

1. **Card Foran Block Karein:**
   * Aap foran **Zarya Mobile App** login karein, **'Cards'** ke option mein jayein aur apna Debit Card **Permanently Block** ya **Freeze** kar dein. 
   * Agar app login karne mein masla ho, toh foran hamari helpline par call karein taake hum aapka card system se block kar sakein.

2. **Ghair Mutawaqa (Unauthorized) Transaction ki Complaint:**
   * Card block karne ke baad, hamen transaction ki details (tareekh, waqt aur raqam) batayein taake hum foran dispute darj kar sakein.
   * State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) ke mutabiq Card/ATM disputes ka turnaround time **24 se 48 working hours** hai (aur agar Raast ke zarye hui ho toh **24 working hours**).

**Ahem Hifazati Hidayat:**
Baraye meharbani apna **ATM PIN, OTP, ya Password** kisi ke sath bhi share na karein. Zarya Bank ka koi numainda aap se yeh maloomat kabhi nahi mangta.

Aap ba-asani app se card block kar pa rahe hain, ya hum aapki mazeed madad karein?

samples.user_query: Business payment karni thi supplier ko, Biometric verification fail ho rahi hai bar bar camera mein. dukaan ka kaam ruka hua hai foran status dein.
samples.response:
Assalam-o-Alaikum ji! Aap ko pesh aane wali pareshani aur karobari kaam mein rukawat ke liye hum nihayat maazrat khwah hain. Hum samajh sakte hain ke supplier ki payment aap ke liye kitni zaroori hai.

Biometric verification camera mein clear na hone ki wajah se aksar fail ho jati hai. Baraye meherbani foran ye chand baatein aazma kar dekhein:

1. **Roshni (Lighting):** Apne chehre par munasib roshni rakhein aur peechay zyada tez roshni na ho.
2. **Camera Lens:** Phone ka front camera kisi saaf kapray se saaf kar lein.
3. **Pehchaan (Face Alignment):** Chehra bilkul screen ke diye gaye daairay (frame) ke andar seedha rakhein aur glasses/mask utaar dein.
4. **App Permission:** Phone ki settings mein check karein ke Zarya App ko camera ki permission allow hai.

Agar phir bhi verification mukammal na ho, toh baraye meherbani hamari helpline **(021-111-ZARYA)** par foran rabta farmaiye taake hum priority par aap ka masla hal kar sakein. 

*Hifazati Hidayat: Baraye meherbani kisi ke sath bhi apna OTP, PIN ya password share mat kijiyega; Zarya Bank ka koi numainda ye maloomat kabhi nahi maangta.* 

Aap ka masla hal karna hamari awaleen tarjeeh hai, ji!

samples.user_query: Bohat pareshani hai, unauthorized activity hui hai mere account pe! acc maintenance certificate lena hai embassy ke liye, charges kya hain? Main kya karoon abhi, kindly guide karein?!
samples.response:
Assalam-o-Alaikum moazzaz sarif! Ji, aapki pareshani hum ba-khoobi samajh saktay hain. Aap bilkul fikar na karein, hum aapki poori madad ke liye hazir hain. 

Aap foran yeh iqdamat uthayein:

**1. Account ki Hifazat (Pehla aur Zaroori Qadam):**
* Foran **Zarya Mobile App** login karein aur 'Card Management' mein ja kar apna Debit Card **Block/Freeze** kar dein taake mazeed koi transaction na ho sakay.
* Agar app tak rasai nahi hai to foran hamari **Helpline** par call kar ke apna account freeze karwayen aur is unauthorized activity ka dispute darj karwayen.
* *Hifazati Hidayat:* Baraye meherbani apna **PIN, Password ya OTP** kisi ke sath bhi share mat kijiyega—Zarya Bank ka koi numainda kabhi yeh maloomat nahi maangta.

---

**2. Account Maintenance Certificate:**
* Embassy ke liye certificate aap Zarya App ke **'Services' / 'Documents'** section se ba-asani PDF format mein download kar saktay hain.
* Digital certificate aam tor par **Muft (Free)** hota hai. Agar aapko physical signed/stamped copy darkar ho to Schedule of Charges (SOC) ke mutabiq baraye-naam charges (with FED/tax) laagu hotay hain.

Aap pehle foran apna account/card secure karein. Mazeed kisi bhi rehnumai ke liye hum har waqt hazir hain!

samples.user_query: Aoa bro, check this out: ek message aya hai ke meri 25 lakh ki lottery nikli hai benazir program se aur zarya bank account verify karna hai. bro urgently needed hai.
samples.response:
Wa Alaikum Assalam ji, moazzaz sarif!

Aap ki fikar bilkul samajh aati hai, lekin barah-e-karam foran hoshiyar ho jayen—**yeh message mukammal tor par farzi (fraud/scam) hai.** 

Zarya Digital Bank ya Benazir Income Support Program (BISP) aisi koi lottery ya inaami schemes nahi chalate, aur na hi bank aisi kisi verification ke liye messages bhejta hai.

**Aap ki hifazat ke liye zaroori hidayat:**
1. Kisi bhi fard ko apna **OTP, PIN, Password, ya CNIC number** hargiz share na karein. Zarya Bank kabhi bhi aap se yeh maloomat nahi maangta.
2. Us message mein diye gaye kisi bhi link par click na karein aur na hi us number par call karein.
3. Us number ko foran block kar dein.

Agar aap ne ghalti se pehle hi koi maloomat share kar di hain, toh barah-e-karam bila-taakheer hamari official helpline par rabta farmayein taake aap ka account foran mehfooz kiya ja sake.

Hum aap ki hifazat ke liye hamesha hazir hain, ji!

2. Kisi ke sath bhi apna **OTP, PIN, Password ya account ki maloomat share na karein** (Zarya Bank kabhi aap se aisi maloomat nahi mangta).
3. Aise frawdiye messages aur calls ko foran block karein.

Apni mehnat ki kamayi ko mehfooz rakhein. Agar aap ko mazeed koi rehnumai chahiye toh hum aap ki khidmat ke liye hazir hain.
